name: Fresh Luxury Bundle - Rasasi Hawas for Him, Khadlaj Shiyaaka Snow, & Rayhaan Pacific Aura
english_product_name: Fresh Luxury Bundle - Rasasi Hawas for Him, Khadlaj Shiyaaka Snow, & Rayhaan Pacific Aura
description: The Hawas, Shiyaaka Snow & Pacific Aura Bundle is a high-performance fresh fragrance trio built for men who want clean, aquatic, and modern scents that stand out. Rasasi Hawas for Him delivers a powerful aquatic-fresh profile with sweetness and strong projection, making it one of the most popular fresh fragrances in its category. Shiyaaka Snow adds a crisp and clean icy freshness with a smooth, refined character that feels sharp and elegant. Pacific Aura brings a breezy and uplifting coastal vibe, combining citrus freshness with a light aquatic feel for easy daily wear. Together, this bundle covers everything from strong statement freshness to smooth everyday wear, making it perfect for warm weather and high versatility.
